unit.why: A homiletic quotation from Zera Kodesh about building Jerusalem through divine service. Within it sit two short narrated reports from R. Elimelech: in a soul-ascent he saw the Temple vessels he had redeemed carried along, and he said that the prayer of R. Yaakov Yitzhak of Lancut topples a fortress of impurity.

stories.end_quote: מפיל כל מה שבונים וכו' עיי״ש
stories.summary_en: Citing Zera Kodesh, the author reports R. Elimelech's account of a soul-ascent: he saw the Temple vessels being carried and was told these were the vessels he had brought out of exile. R. Elimelech also said that a huge fortress of impurity is built up daily by thousands of builders, and the Minhah prayer of R. Yaakov Yitzhak of Lancut knocks down whatever they build.
